But how much should you expect to pay for these fixtures? The cost can vary significantly based on several factors including wattage, design features, and order quantity For instance, a 150W LED high bay light from Alva starts at around $81.28 per unit if you're purchasing between 200 and 999 pieces. If your needs scale up to over 5,000 units, you might find yourself negotiating prices that could drop even lower—an enticing prospect for businesses looking to save on bulk orders The price range doesn't stop there; depending on specifications such as IP ratings (which indicate weather resistance), lumen output (brightness), and additional features like dimmability or color temperature options (ranging from warm white at 2700K to cool daylight at 6500K), costs can fluctuate widely.
